digest_specification.canonical_json: UTF-8 without BOM; object keys sorted; compact separators; ensure_ascii=false; one trailing LF
digest_specification.identity_set_digests: SHA-256 of a canonical JSON array containing sorted snapshot_identity_digest values; duplicates are preserved
digest_specification.occurrence_discriminator: AST source span plus one-based duplicate ordinal among equal path, symbol, method, operation, table, and fingerprint values
digest_specification.row_digest: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON row before row_digest is added
digest_specification.snapshot_identity_digest: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON snapshot_identity object
